places-molino-de-capel-i-abrigo-del-enga.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-molino-de-capel-i-abrigo-del-enga.story: From Moratalla it runs 166 km to Moratalla; allow about 2 h 52 of riding. It goes by way of friso de los Gitanos o Abrigo del Cazador, Diosa madre, Abrigo del Engarbo and back through Diosa madre. The highest point is about 1,450 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-quilotoa-loop.slogan: Quilotoa Loop – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-quilotoa-loop.story: A mountain loop based around Latacunga, Ecuador, via Sigchos. Key character: caldera lake; highlands; indigenous villages. Surface: mixed.

scenicChapters.title: Quilotoa Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 12 km this is Quilotoa Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
